# Zynda Custom Homes & Remodeling, Inc.

> Licensed, family-owned general contractor in Naples, Florida, serving Naples and Marco Island since 2001: custom homes, condo renovations, whole-home renovations, kitchens, bathrooms, additions, outdoor kitchens and lanais. Originally from Buffalo, New York. Florida license CGC056812, Certified General Contractor, current and active through August 31, 2028 (Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation). Office at 4277 Exchange Ave #10, Naples, FL 34104. Phone (239) 213-1314; email Zyndacustomhomes@gmail.com; Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.

## What they build

- [Custom homes](https://www.zyndahomes.com/#services): new construction with the owner's architect and designer, down to every last detail; they can recommend local architects and interior designers.
- [Condo renovations](https://www.zyndahomes.com/#services): complete renovations of Naples and Marco Island condominiums, including HOA approvals, building requirements and logistics.
- [Whole-home renovations](https://www.zyndahomes.com/#services): full interior renovations of homes and condos.
- [Kitchens](https://www.zyndahomes.com/#services): custom cabinetry, stone countertops, premium appliances and high-end finishes.
- [Bathrooms](https://www.zyndahomes.com/#services): master baths, guest baths and complete renovations.
- [Additions](https://www.zyndahomes.com/#services) and [outdoor kitchens and lanais](https://www.zyndahomes.com/#services).
- Projects range from $100,000 to more than $7,000,000, depending on plans and scope.

## How they work

- [A few projects at a time](https://www.zyndahomes.com/#apart): they intentionally take on only a few projects at a time; they are on site daily; job sites are cleaned up every day (ZipWalls and plastic sheeting contain the dust, floors and furniture are covered); trusted local subcontractors; work comes through referrals, and references are available on request.
- [The condo season](https://www.zyndahomes.com/#year): condo timelines are short. They plan with owners in winter, start in May (demolition, then framing, rough-ins and finishing details) and finish by October 1st. Owners who are away get pictures and progress emails. They advise checking the building's rules early: the earlier the details are settled, the sooner work can start.

## Where they work

- [Naples and Marco Island](https://www.zyndahomes.com/#areas): Pelican Bay, Park Shore, The Moorings, Port Royal, Aqualane Shores, Grey Oaks, Mediterra, Bonita Bay, Gulf Shore Boulevard, Gordon Drive, Royal Harbor, Kensington, Naples Square, Vanderbilt Drive, Casa Mar Lane; on Marco Island, Hideaway Beach Club, Caxambas Court, South Barfield Drive, Via Delfino, Dunnfoire; condominiums including Le Ciel Towers, The Heron in Pelican Bay, Le Dauphin and Westgate.
